footnote_text: Represents 147,058 restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the reporting person on September 24, 2026, for Board service under the Company's 2025 Omnibus Incentive Plan (the "2025 Omnibus Plan"). The RSUs vest in full on the earlier of (i) the date of the Company's 2027 annual meeting of stockholders or (ii) October 24, 2027 (thirteen (13) months following the September 24, 2026 Vesting Start Date), subject to continued service. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Company's Class A common stock.
